import unicodedata
import string

def is_palindrome(text: str) -> bool:
    """Return True if text reads the same forwards and backwards when
    considering only letters and digits, ignoring case and accents."""
    # Normalize to NFKD form to decompose accented characters
    normalized = unicodedata.normalize('NFKD', text)
    # Build a cleaned string: keep only alphanumeric characters, ignore case
    cleaned = [
        ch.lower()
        for ch in normalized
        if ch.isalnum()
        and not unicodedata.combining(ch)  # drop diacritical marks
    ]
    cleaned_str = ''.join(cleaned)
    return cleaned_str == cleaned_str[::-1]
